messages.subject: Re: R-SWAT crashing when entering TxtInOut directory
parts: HI Jilian, I have checked your TxtInOut files. The file "time.sim" in your TxtInOut folder does not follow the standard format of SWAT+ (it should have only 3 lines - see attached figure) but your "time.sim" files have 4 lines.  If you delete the 4th lines R-SWAT will work
